text: Can you close your bag with one hand while holding a coffee?
Here's a test every bag should pass. One hand holds a coffee. The other has to find your things and shut the bag again, all while you keep walking.
Most bags want both hands, one to hold the bag and one to fight the catch. This one has a clasp that snaps shut with one hand. So watch it do exactly that.
Coffee in your left hand. Right hand on the clasp. One press, and it snaps shut. No fumbling, no second hand, and the coffee never moves.
Now open it again, still one-handed. Your phone, wallet and keys each have their own spot, so there's no digging through the bottom of the bag.
Result: coffee still full, bag still shut, and one hand left over. That's a pass.
The secret is that one-hand clasp. And when your hands get busier, the adjustable strap goes from handbag to crossbody, so the bag stays out of your way.
